name: Back to Top Button
author: seosbg

sections.description:
Back to Top Button adds a button that appears when visitors scroll down and smoothly takes them back to the top of the page. Install, activate – done. Everything else is optional and can be changed in a clear settings page with a live preview.

Made by SEOS Themes – free and premium WordPress themes for shops, news, blogs, photographers, restaurants, real estate and more. Browse all WordPress themes at seosthemes.com

Icons & content

  • 14 crisp built-in SVG icons (chevron, arrows, rocket, hand, home…) – no icon font needed
  • 171 bundled image icons or your own image from the Media Library
  • Icon + text, text only (e.g. “Back to top”) or any Font Awesome 4.7 icon
  • 4 layouts for icon + text, letter case, font weight and font family

Style

  • Unlimited colors, gradient backgrounds, hover colors
  • Width, height, font/icon size, corner radius (square, rounded, circle, pill)
  • Border, shadow, glow, glass (blur) effect, opacity and hover opacity

Animation

  • Appear animations: fade, slide up, slide from the side, zoom, flip
  • Hover effects: lift, grow, shrink, tilt, icon moves up
  • Attention animations: pulse ring, bounce, shake, heartbeat
  • Scroll progress ring around the button, optional percentage
  • 9 scroll effects (swing, linear, smooth, bounce, native smooth scroll, instant…) and any duration

Behaviour

  • Show after X pixels or X % of the page
  • Show only when the visitor scrolls up, auto-hide after X seconds
  • Scroll to the top or to any element (CSS selector) with an offset for sticky headers
  • The animation stops when the visitor scrolls by hand

Position & mobile

  • Left, center or right, distances from the bottom and the sides, z-index
  • Separate mobile size and position, hide on mobile or on desktop, hide the text on mobile

Display rules

  • Hide on the front page, blog, single posts, archives, search, 404
  • Hide for logged-in users or for visitors
  • Show only on / hide on specific post IDs, limit to post types

Accessibility & speed

  • Real keyboard support, screen reader label, focus moves to the top after scrolling
  • Respects the “reduce motion” system setting
  • Lightweight vanilla JavaScript – no jQuery required

Tools

  • Live preview for desktop and mobile
  • Export / import settings as JSON, reset to defaults
  • Custom CSS and extra CSS class
  • Shortcode [back_to_top text="Back to top"] and the CSS class bttb-scroll-top for your own links
  • Developer filters: bttb_settings, bttb_show_button, bttb_button_html and window.bttbScrollTop()

Translations

English and Bulgarian (Български) included.

sections.installation:
Install via Plugins > Add New

  1. Search for “Back to Top Button”
  2. Click “Install Now”
  3. Click “Activate”

Via ZIP / FTP

  1. Unzip the ZIP file and upload the back-to-top-button folder to wp-content/plugins.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Open “Back To Top Button” in the admin menu to customize it.
sections.faq:
I updated from version 1.x. Will my button change?

No. All 1.x settings (colors, speed, position, margins, size, radius, opacity and your image) are kept and read exactly as before, the button keeps the ID #totop, the same Font Awesome arrow, and Font Awesome + jQuery keep loading like in 1.x. New features are off until you turn them on.

Can I make the button load faster?

Yes. In “Advanced & Tools” turn off “Load Font Awesome 4 & jQuery (1.x compatibility)” if your theme does not need them, and use one of the built-in SVG icons.

The button is hidden behind a chat widget

Raise “Layer (z-index)” or change “Distance from bottom” in “Position & Mobile”.

Where can I find more themes and plugins?

At https://seosthemes.com/.

  • Fixed: invalid “Set Color” values saved by old versions are ignored
